events.name: Bash
events.head: Check on-disk state of reminders code, leftovers, and child tasks
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; echo "--- grep batch/held"; git grep -n -i -E "emails/batch|held until Tantra|TANTRA_NOTE|TANTRA_WAIT|per-contact send" -- cloud/src app/src cloud/funnel | head -20; echo "--- keys in reminders.ts"; grep -n -E "plan_ready|missed|replay|low_engagement|nudge|registered" cloud/src/reminders.ts | head -40; echo "--- copy keys"; grep -n -E "^\s*(export|[a-z_0-9]+:\s*\{)|replay|nudge" cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts | head -40; echo "--- wc"; wc -l cloud/src/reminders.ts cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs; ech

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate follow-up campaign code, branch merge state, uncommitted diffs, and task logs
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; echo "--- T-235 code"; git grep -n -l -i -E "Missed today|Low engagement nudge" -- cloud app/scripts | head; echo "--- branch"; git branch -a --list '*tantra-campaign*'; git log --oneline -1 tantra-campaign-import 2>&1 | head -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor f0b5528 HEAD && echo "f0b5528 merged" || echo "f0b5528 NOT merged"; echo "--- unpushed"; git fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -1; git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD; git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main; echo "--- diff stat"; git diff --stat -- app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs cloud/funnel/

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the remainder of the saved output and the uncommitted diffs
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; f=/Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/d1bfb55e-55af-475b-adb9-d8e60b309d28/tool-results/b4wkwrqbt.txt; grep -n -E "^--- " $f; awk '/^--- T-235 full/{p=1} p' $f | cut -c1-1100 | head -40; echo; echo "--- probe diff rest"; git diff -- app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | sed -n 14,40p; echo "--- worker diff"; git diff -- cloud/funnel/worker.js | grep -E "^[+-]" | cut -c1-260; echo "--- who touches"; git log --oneline -3 -- app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs cloud/funnel/worker.js; git log --oneline origin/m

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show T-235 latest log lines and worker diff plus commit lists
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; f=/Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/d1bfb55e-55af-475b-adb9-d8e60b309d28/tool-results/b95ltb7i5.txt; awk '/^T-235 2026-10-0[9]|^T-235 2026-10-1/' $f | cut -c1-900; echo "--- worker diff"; awk '/^--- worker diff/{p=1} p' $f | cut -c1-240 | head -50

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect pending branch commit, probe usage, pass.py fields, wrangler config, coordination log
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; echo "--- f0b5528"; git show --stat --format=%s f0b5528 | tail -6; git merge-base main tantra-campaign-import | cut -c1-8; echo "--- probe header"; sed -n 1,36p app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | cut -c1-220; echo "--- pass.py set fields"; grep -n -E "done_when|spec|blockers|waiting|def cmd_|add_argument|status in|STATUSES" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -40; echo "--- wrangler"; ls cloud | head -30; grep -n -E "^name|main|database_name|\[env" cloud/wrangler.toml 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- LOG"; grep -n -i -E "publish held|DEPLOYED" /User

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply the wording commit to main, then find local run and deploy conventions
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git diff --quiet -- cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts && git cherry-pick -x f0b5528 2>&1 | tail -2; git grep -n -c -E "TANTRA_NOTE|TANTRA_WAIT|per-contact send|held until Tantra" -- cloud/src app/src | head; echo "--- how to run locally"; grep -n -E "8960|8882|vendor-sim|wrangler dev|local-runner" app/scripts/run-chain.sh cloud/package.json cloud/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls cloud/scripts | head -30; lsof -iTCP:8960 -iTCP:8882 -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | tail -3; echo "--- deploy how"; grep -n -i -E "clean worktree|wrangler deploy|public/admin" /Use

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how earlier runs started the local centre and simulator for the probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -1 | cut -c1-120; grep -o -h -E "[^\"]{0,260}(--port 8960|8960 )[^\"]{0,260}" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-235.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-123.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-234.json 2>/dev/null | grep -E "wrangler|vendor-sim" | head -4; echo "--- sim args"; grep -n -E "argparse|add_argument|PORT|8882|environ" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -12; echo "--- vendor() in worker"; grep -rn -E "VENDOR_SIM|SIM_URL|VENDOR_BASE" cloud/src/*.ts | head -5; sed -n 1,12p cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh; grep -n -E "VENDOR|SIM" cloud/.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read Worker config essentials and probe environment needs
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; grep -n -E "\"(name|main|database_name|binding|directory|migrations_dir|crons|command)\"" wrangler.jsonc | head -20; cat scripts/build.sh | head -20; grep -rn -o -E "env\.DODO[A-Z_]*" src/*.ts | sort -u -t: -k3 | head -5; grep -n -E "DODO_SECRET|TEST_NOW|test clock|x-test-now|SIM_PUBLIC" ../app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | head -8 | cut -c1-200; ls migrations | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start an isolated local centre and vendor simulator for the probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; P=/tmp/t123-probe; rm -rf $P; mkdir -p $P; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to $P/state >$P/mig.log 2>&1 </dev/null; tail -2 $P/mig.log | cut -c1-160; (SIM_PORT=8882 SIM_PUBLIC=http://127.0.0.1:8882 SIM_STATE=$P/sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py >$P/sim.log 2>&1 &); (nohup npx wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --port 8960 --ip 127.0.0.1 --persist-to $P/state --test-scheduled --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8882 --var PUBLIC_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8960 --var READER_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8882/reader/ --var
